attchmntText: Paras Petrofils Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Paras Petrofils Limited has filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange, BSE Limited, and The Calcutta Stock Exchange Limited regarding the newspaper advertisement for its Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026. The advertisement was published in the Financial Express in English and vernacular languages on 07th November, 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, 2015. The information is also hosted on the company website at www.paraspetrofils.in.

attchmntText: Unaudited Financial Statements (Standalone) for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended on September 30, 2026
Paras Petrofils Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
